svg.text: FIT · ATHLETIC · PART 2.1 — VO2 MAX & MITOCHONDRIA
One number. Two levers. One locked.
VO₂ max is the output of a single oxygen pipeline. The Fick equation splits it into three
terms: HRmax is bolted shut by genetics — but stroke volume (the heart, the ceiling) and
oxygen extraction (the mitochondria, the floor) are both trainable, by two different protocols.
That’s why the 80/20 split isn’t a tradition. It’s the biology, read out loud.
THE FICK MASTER BUS · the spine
Cardiac output (Q) = HR × SV. VO₂max = blood moved × O₂ pulled per litre. Two of three terms move — train those two.
THE DELIVERY-CHAIN FLOW SCHEMATIC ▸ read left → right
THE TWO PROTOCOL FEEDS ▸ each wire lands on a different organ
Drag the heart to near-max stroke volume and HOLD it
→ LV chamber + autonomic remodel. 4-min bout = sweet spot.
Gentle Ca²⁺/AMPK signal for HOURS → PGC-1α dose accumulates
→ biogenesis. Recruits Type I fibres (densest mitochondria).
80 / 20 POLARIZED — two organs · two stimuli · two adaptations. Easy builds the floor · hard builds the ceiling. Run both, because the cell biology says so.
LACTATE IS FUEL — not waste, not “the burn.”
OXIDATIVE TISSUE (heart · brain · liver) → burned aerobically for ATP
LT2 rises because clearance & re-use improve — not because you make less.
shared origin → huge spread of response
HERITAGE: ~400 mL/min avg / 20 wks; trainability h²≈47%.
Track YOUR own line. Switch the stimulus if you don’t respond.
Central (stroke vol) fades faster than peripheral.
Intervals matter MORE with age — not less.
WHY IT PREDICTS HOW LONG YOU LIVE
A high VO₂max REQUIRES all of:
A COMPOSITE of system integrity — can’t fake any
of the five. That’s why it tracks longevity.
Sources: Raleigh 2018 (PMID 29733694) · Wright PGC-1α→NRF/TFAM (PMC3060512) · HERITAGE Bouchard 1999 (PMC5688475) · Mandsager 2018 JAMA Netw Open (n=122,007).
